definitions.dAlb: near minus reference white-sky shortwave albedo, percentage points
definitions.dSWabs: -SW x dAlb, W m-2; SW is ERA5-Land downward solar radiation of the window-quarter
definitions.S: ERA5-Land snow cover of the window-quarter, standardized within the quarter sample
definitions.dSnow: near minus reference MOD10A2 snow frequency (share of valid 8-day periods with snow), percentage points
definitions.Tgroup: background temperature below -0.5, within +/-0.5 and above +0.5 primary SD (descriptives only)
definitions.LAIsf: LAI contrast from good retrievals without the snow/ice flag, primary LAI scale

BH_family: LAI, conditional LAI, dSWabs and LAI x S coefficients of all non-anchor models
